remarks: Sought-after Rivers Edge offers this fabulous 4-level townhome with spacious, light-filled living throughout! The open living room and dining area feature hardwood floors and crown moldings, creating the perfect space for everyday living and entertaining. Eat-in kitchen boasts granite countertops and sliders to a private balcony for relaxing outdoors. Upstairs, the bright primary bedroom showcases soaring ceilings and a walk-in closet, while a second bedroom and hall bath complete the level. The versatile third-floor loft/flex space is ideal for a home office, playroom, or guest area. Lower level features a large laundry/mudroom with direct access to the EV-ready garage. Enjoy resort-style amenities including an in-ground pool, clubhouse and fitness room. Conveniently located just steps to Springdale Village shops, restaurants and the Springdale train station. A must see!
